name: Unitree G1-D Ultimate
summary: G1 upper body with two 7-DOF arms on a lifting column and a wheeled base, built to collect robot training data and do light handling.

germany.statusNote: RobotShop EU lists G1-D Ultimate A-E with euro prices (ships in about 6 weeks); Generation Robots quotes Standard and Ultimate versions.

priceEur.note: Ultimate A with grippers, tax included.

sellers.name: RobotShop (eu.robotshop.com, RobotShop Inc.)
sellers.note: Ultimate A with Dex1-1 grippers; Ultimate B-E with Dex3-1 or BrainCo hands EUR 51,170-56,763; ships in about 6 weeks.

sellers.name: Generation Robots (Génération Robots, with Generation Robots GmbH in Berlin)
sellers.note: Lists STANDARD A-E and ULTIMATE A-E; page 'from' price EUR 31,500 excl. VAT; quote on request.

sellers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics (quadruped.de)
sellers.note: G1D-U6 35,400 EUR net (RobotShop gives G1-D-U6 as the manufacturer number of Ultimate A); U7-U10 43,000-47,700 net; all "available from 02.11.2026". Page range starts at 25,900 net for the stationary U1.

specs.label: Height
specs.conditions: 1.26 m at minimum, 1.68 m at maximum column height

specs.label: Max. payload per arm
specs.conditions: maximum per arm, about 3 kg; varies strongly with arm posture

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Head binocular camera, 2 wrist cameras; base LiDAR, 2 depth cameras, collision and low-obstacle sensors

capabilities.sdk: Unitree secondary development; data collection and training platform
notes: Every Ultimate version ships with an end effector: Ultimate A has Dex1-1 two-finger grippers; B-E use three-finger Dex3-1 or five-finger BrainCo hands.
Wheeled base for flat indoor floors; the cheaper G1-D Standard has no drive base.

evidence.task: Collects teleoperated manipulation data and runs trained models
